verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviews automatically scan every PR with no configuration, offer custom rules/comment exclusions, and GT MCP explicitly supports breaking large AI-agent-generated changes into reviewable stacked PRs — directly addressing reviewing agent-authored code. However, evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent benchmarking of review accuracy/volume specifically for AI-generated code, and community commentary shows some skepticism about the direction of AI features (though not a concrete failure report). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of review quality at scale on AI-authored PRs specifically, and any metrics on catch-rate or false-positive rate.
